hallways1.text:
```There’s a rumor every October, where from 9pm to 10pm, if you hear footsteps behind you in the first floor hallway of the west corridor, do not turn around. Will you?``` 
The hallways are dim, lit only by the wall mounted lanterns placed every few steps away from each other. Like this, the Academy looks more peaceful… but also, eerie. The bustle and noise of students attending classes is absent, replaced with a silence that makes every footstep sound louder, echoing along the halls.

classroom.text: You peek into one of the many classrooms and find… an empty classroom! The chairs are a little messy. Whoever was tasked with cleaning this classroom did a bad job…

classroom2.text:
As you open the classroom door, a swarm of bats come flying straight at you!

…Thankfully, they pass right through your body. They’re nothing more than a harmless illusion. Happy Night of Veils.

classroom3.text:
You poke your head into one of the classrooms and find a skull on top of one of the desks.

Inside… you’ll find a wonderful stash of {{d6}} candies.

classroom4.text:
As you move to peek into one of the classrooms, you hear it. Footsteps. Right behind you. Coming closer, closer, closer-

and right when it's behind you, the footsteps stop.

classroom5.text:
All the classroom doors are locked. You check each one. Until you find one that's unlocked.

Peering inside, there doesn't seem to be anything special about the classroom though. The shaows are a little ominous from the forest trees closeby, but that's it.

You leave the classroom.

classroom6.text:
You place your hand on the doorknob, about to look inside one of the classrooms, when a teacher suddenly clears their throat.

'What are you doing here so close to curfew?'

You're sent back to your dorms.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

lantern.text: Lanterns lit by magical fire, it’s warmer when you get closer to them – a good break from the cold night. Cozy. Nothing seems to be amiss.

lantern2.text:
You approach one of the lanterns. You’re not sure why, maybe it’s because it was warm, and the fire inside looks so mesmerizing — but you reach out to touch a lantern, maybe grab one when you explore, when —

*Crash!*

One of the lanterns falls to the ground. The glass shatters on impact.

lantern3.text:
Getting closer towards the magical lanterns when out of nowhere — the flames inside the lanterns suddenly extinguish.

You are now surrounded by darkness. 

(You may roll for a lightsource! The hallways are empty, no strange footsteps are heard.)

lantern4.text:
You notice that the shadows cast by one of the lanterns look a little strange… perhaps even candy shaped…? 

…How lucky! You find {{d6}} candies.

lantern5.text:
Getting closer towards the lanterns, perhaps you lost your footing, or maybe someone bumped into you. Whatever the case, you hit one of the lanterns and it comes crashing down.

'Hey!'

A teacher catches you and sends you back to the dorms. You're lucky you didn't get penalized for property damage...
```INVESTIGATION: END```

floor.text: Academy floors, always neat and shiny. The janitor does an excellent job of keeping the campus clean. There’s nothing of note. It’s just floors.

floor2.text: The floors are just floors. The shadows cast from the lanterns on the wall are a little creepy, but that's to be expected with the time of day.

floor3.text:
You look at your shadows cast onto the floors, flickering from the lanterns mounted on the walls. 

Then your shadows shift. It turns.... into... the shape of a pumpkin! Before it morphs back into your shadow. Cute...

floor4.text: You catch a glimpse of something — oh? It's {{d6}} candies on the floor. Sneaky!

floor5.text:
You look at your shadows cast onto the floors, flickering from the lanterns mounted on the walls. 

A shadow seems to loom over you for a few seconds.

When you look up, no one else is with you.

floor6.text: There are leaves on the floor. That's odd... all the windows and doors are closed.

floor7.text:
Before you can do anything else, a teacher suddenly clears their throat.

'What are you doing here so close to curfew?'

You're sent back to your dorms.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn.text:
You find…. nothing? The hallways are empty.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn2.text:
You turn around and -- it's the janitor! They're cleaning the hallways. Best not to disturb them.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn3.text:
You turn around and --

BOO!

A ghost jumpscares you.

Or at least, a ghost in the form of a lumpy figure made of pillows covered in a sheet. It flops to the floor before disappearing.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn4.text:
You turn around and find no one.

What’s that? Upon closer inspection, you find {{d6}} candies tucked behind the bust statue of a famous mage along one of the walls.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn5.text:
You catch a glimpse of something — a shadow? it’s hard to tell — turning the corner right as you turn around. If you try to chase it, you’ll find the hallways empty. But you swear you saw it. You did. Something was following you.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn6.text:
You find… nothing.

Until, that is, you look down.

There’s a strange crackle in the air– almost as if the air itself is misshapen. It lasts for just a second. It’s gone before you can even tell what it was.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

turn7.text:
You turn around and—

No one is there. What you do find, however, is an open door, leading towards the outside.

It’s the door closest to the forest.
```INVESTIGATION: END```
